messages:
elaine: Uploaded a fresh draft for the launch blog (Optimize). Big open questions: primary CTA (watch a short benchmark demo video vs gated benchmark PDF), exact hero stat language, and HubSpot/Segment wiring. Need legal + ops eyes today so design can finish CTAs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamie: My quick take: lead with the demo video as primary CTA (less friction) and surface a gated PDF in the sidebar for intent capture. Video > webinar for immediate eyeballs. We can A/B button color + copy.

maria: Legal: can't use absolutes or competitor comparisons. Current hero says "50% lower for everyone" which is risky. Change to: "In our benchmark tests, Optimize cut per-token inference cost by up to 48% and increased throughput by up to 3x (see appendix for rig and raw numbers)." Also require appendix to include model version, sequence length, GPU, and reproducibility notes.

nora: Design: will make two hero variants (video-first and stat-first). CTA pair idea: Primary = "Watch 90s benchmark demo" (solid) Secondary = "Download full benchmark" (outline). Need final hero sentence and the CDN paths for video + PDF. Can deliver hero comps by EOD if copy locks.

dante: Ops notes: For HubSpot/Segment we should send a hidden field campaign_id=optimize_launch_2026 and source_detail={blog_video|blog_pdf}. Proposed workflow names:
- Launch - Optimize - Blog - Video Registrants
- Launch - Optimize - Blog - PDF Downloads
For PDF downloads, create workflow that tags leads with "benchmark_pdf" and sets lifecycle to MQL if company_size > 150. For video clicks just add to nurture list, no automatic MQL.

ops-bot: Quick ops checklist created. Also reminder: confirm redirect URL (no open redirect), and add GA4 event `optimize_blog_cta_click`.

elaine: Updated hero per Maria: "In our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 48% while improving throughput by as much as 3x. See appendix for test rig and raw results." Pushed to doc and added appendix stub.

jamie: Love it. For social and paid we'll want separate UTMs. Suggest utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_q2, utm_content={video|pdf}. For the 90s demo we'll append utm_content=video90.

maria: Legal sign-off pending appendix details. Once the appendix includes seed numbers and exact config files, I'll clear it.

dante: Ops implementation detail: we'll host the video and PDF on Cloudflare Workers-backed CDN. For the PDF download, use a short link that triggers a server-side event to create a HubSpot contact if email param present, otherwise show the download modal. Sample server snippet (pseudo):
```
GET /d/optimize-bench.pdf?e=<<email>>&cid=optimize_launch_2026 -> log event, create contact stub in HS via API, return 302 -> /cdn/optimize/optimize-bench.pdf
```
This avoids client-side calls and keeps GA/Segment events consistent.

nora: I can export the 90s demo with burned captions and a 15s stat-first cut for social. Will put both in /cdn/marketing/optimize-launch/. Please confirm final CTAs and UTM strings so overlays are exact.

content-bot: Publish checklist (template):
- final copy attached (elaine)
- legal signoff on appendix (maria)
- hero image + video + PDF uploaded to CDN (nora)
- HubSpot workflows created & tested (dante)
- UTMs agreed (jamie)
- GA4 + Segment events instrumented (dante)

elaine: Proposed publish time is Wed 09:00 PT. If legal sign-off and assets are uploaded by EOD tomorrow I'll schedule. Also, small ask: add `utm_content=video90` on the blog hero and `utm_content=pdf_full` on the sidebar link so we can separate conversions.

maria: I'll review appendix now and post sign-off in thread when done. If I don't respond within 6 hours assume not cleared.

jamie: I'll prepare two social copy variants (stat-first headline vs benefit-first headline) and schedule experiments. Tag me when creatives are on CDN.

dante: Workflows created in staging and paused. I'll run end-to-end tests after assets are live and then unpause at publish. Also added the hidden `campaign_id` and `source_detail` fields to forms.

elaine: Awesome. If no objections I'm locking this draft and scheduling for Wed 09:00 PT pending Maria's final note. Thanks all :rocket:
